claim_map.title: Bounded query validation
claim_map.text: The proposal bypasses validation for trade original ID queries. Other described queries require value date and at least booking entity or counterparty. Payment date permits =, in, bet, <=, and >=. Booking entity FMID and cashflow state permit = and in. Multiple cashflow states need no extra field validation. Opening an invalid saved filter warns but keeps it visible. Invalid filters cannot be saved, created, or searched. Deletion remains allowed.
